notes: 1.1.171: Page system - each page does ALL the task's links in one switch (page 1: link 1, 2, 3... then switch to page 2), and what a page does shows in that page's own Status; Count fields take up to 99999 (e.g. 1800-3600 seconds); Login Method Uid|Pass - an account's first login is UID + password even with a cookie stored, later relogins may use the cookie.
